title: The Vitruvian tool catalog
description: catalog/tools.json: the tools VitruvianSoftware lists, each pinned to one download. The app reads the signed copy the website serves. Rules JSON Schema cannot say are in catalog_rules.py: no id is listed twice, versions are semver, a download address has no segment that walks up, and no two commands of a tool share an id.

version.description: The version of this file's shape. The app reads version 1 only.

generated.description: When the list was last changed, in UTC. Each change sets it later than the one before: the app refuses a list older than one it has already accepted.

localizedText.description: As in the tool manifest: text keyed by language tag, English under en required.

id.description: The tool's id, as its manifest gives it.

version.description: The manifest's version, copied. Semver, so the app can tell which is newer.

protocol.description: The manifest's protocol, copied. An app that does not speak it does not show the entry.

minimumAppVersion.description: The oldest Vitruvian that may install it. An older one does not show it.

url.description: A zip of the tool's folder, with vitruvian-tool.json at its top, from a GitHub release of VitruvianSoftware. Another place is added here and in catalog_rules.py by a reviewed change.

sha256.description: The zip's SHA-256, in lower-case hex.

size.description: The zip's size in bytes. At most 256 MB, the most a tool's folder may hold.

commands.description: The manifest's commands, each its id and title, copied.
